title: ANC4 Coverage Gap: Gaya vs Nalanda (2021–2023)
question: Why is Gaya's ANC4 coverage below Nalanda's between 2021 and 2023?

view.title: ANC4 Coverage Gap: Gaya vs Nalanda (2021–2023)
view.note: The chart shows the percentage of registered pregnancies that completed four or more antenatal visits for each district. The vertical distance between the two lines at any year is the coverage gap in percentage points. This file can show that a gap exists and how wide it is, but it cannot tell you why the gap exists—no explanatory variables (such as health-worker numbers, travel distance, or programme changes) are included.

insight_specs.message: This file contains only the number of registered pregnancies and the number that completed four or more antenatal visits. It has no information about staffing, outreach, infrastructure, or any other factor that could explain why one district's coverage is lower than another's. The gap is visible, but its cause is not in this data.

insights.label: What this data cannot answer
insights.text: This file shows differences and changes, but it has no explanatory variables and cannot establish why they occurred.

source.provenance: Deterministic synthetic district-level ANC fixture created for the benchmark; no people or sensitive records. District names are illustrative and values are not official statistics.
